"I believe the war must not and cannot spread to the Mediterranean," Meloni said on the sidelines of the European Council in Brussels. "I believe we must be very clear on this point with our Ukrainian friends, and we must also be clear with our partners. "I believe we must also do our best to continue to help Ukraine defend itself." Deputy Premier and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani spok

items.t: Italy considering boosting security of troops in Libya after Ukraine's attacks
items.m: (ANSA) - ROME, 26 NOV - The government is considering boosting security measures for the 200 Italian military personnel involved in the Miasit mission in Libya and deployed between Tripoli and Misrata, following the Ukrainian attacks on Russian ships in Benghazi on November 22, military sources said on Thursday. Defence Minister Guido Crosetto summoned the Ukrainian military attaché, who was accompanied by Ukrainian Ambassador Ihor Brusylo, on Wednesday to discuss the situation following those attacks, La Repubblica reported on Thursday. Both Moscow and Kyiv have recruited thousands of foreigners in their armies since Russia launched its offensive in Ukraine...

items.t: Jared Kushner says Putin has shown ‘restraint’ in Ukraine and promised not to use nuclear weapons
items.m: U.S. presidential envoy Jared Kushner claimed that Vladimir Putin had promised not to use nuclear weapons in Ukraine, speaking in an interview with the MD Meets podcast. “So far Putin has showed restraint. He’s agreed not to use nuclear weapons, which obviously is a big thing,” Kushner said. He also described Putin as “very organized” and said he has “some very strong perspectives.” “People can like what he’s done, they can not like what he’s done, but he’s definitely a grandmaster of politics. He’s a historic figure,” Kushner said.
